Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method for treating an ocular condition, the method comprising: administering to the interior of an eye a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC) to a mammal suffering from an ocular condition, wherein the composition also comprises a viscosity inducing component in an amount effective to increase the viscosity of the composition to a viscosity at __25°C__ of __at least 10 cps__ at a shear rate of about 0.1/second, wherein said viscosity inducing component is injectable into the vitreous of a mammalian eye without permanently diminishing visual acuity.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a solution.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a gel.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a suspension.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein __the MAAC comprises an inhibitor of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) activity__.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 5 wherein said MAAC comprises __a polypeptide__.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The method of claim 6 wherein said polypeptide is __an angiogenesis inhibitor__.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The method of claim 14 wherein said polypeptide is __bevacizumab__.

Claim 16 (Cancelled)

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises __a hyaluronic acid__.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The method of claim 20 wherein said hyaluronic acid has a molecular weight in the range from about 10,000 Daltons to about 2 million Daltons.

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The method of claim 20 wherein said hyaluronic acid has a molecular weight in the range of about 100,000 Daltons to about 1.5 million Daltons.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The method of claim 20 wherein said hyaluronic acid has a molecular weight in the range of about 200,000 Daltons to about 1 million Daltons.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 100 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 1000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 10,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 70,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 200,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

Claim 29 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 250,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 300,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said composition is administered to the interior of said eye by placement into the posterior segment of the eye through a 27-gauge needle.

Claim 32 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said condition comprises a condition of the posterior segment of the eye.

Claim 33 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein said condition is __macular degeneration__.

Claim 34 (Cancelled)

Claim 36 (Currently amended): The method of claim 14 wherein said condition is __macular degeneration__.

Claim 37 (Currently amended): A pharmaceutical composition for intravitreal administration to treat an ocular condition comprising a MAAC and a high viscosity hyaluronic acid carrier.
